project.title: Shared Rust workspace/company access policy
project.goal: Port exact access decisions and require explicitly bound current identity/control observations
project.scope: Pure application-layer R13 increment; full goal unchanged

action.access_policy.description: Evaluate exact private/public workspace/company permission from trusted bound facts

preconditions: Typed permission vocabulary; facts supplied by trusted current source adapter, never caller claims.
postconditions: Only non-disclosing allowed boolean; no data effects or authority token.

authorization.rationale: Pure immutable decision; wrong identity/scope/readiness/role deny, prior allow cannot fence future writes.

boundaries.rationale: Pure immutable decision; wrong identity/scope/readiness/role deny, prior allow cannot fence future writes.

atomicity.rationale: Pure immutable decision; wrong identity/scope/readiness/role deny, prior allow cannot fence future writes.

concurrency.rationale: Pure immutable decision; wrong identity/scope/readiness/role deny, prior allow cannot fence future writes.

idempotency.rationale: Pure immutable decision; wrong identity/scope/readiness/role deny, prior allow cannot fence future writes.

action.access_policy.behavior: Evaluate immutable bound facts with no I/O or reusable grant

boundary.responsibility: Shared access policy over trusted observations
boundary.rationale: All product interfaces need the same company isolation policy.
excludes: Authentication, storage, revocation fencing, actor inference and source adapters

scenario.normal.description: All roles and permissions match independent matrix and actual legacy policy.

scenario.when: Evaluate native policy and corresponding unchanged legacy policy.
scenario.then: All roles and permissions match independent matrix and actual legacy policy.
